deadeye.name: Deadeye
effects: Focus: aim at full Stamina to enter Focus; shooting then costs no Stamina
Focus precision: more headshot and weakspot damage; Rinse and Reload: faster reload after aimed neutralization
Deep Breath: time slows during Focus; No Sweat: neutralizations reduce its ending Stamina cost
Head to Head: Focus refreshes after neutralization; Pull!: stronger airborne grenade shots
Deadeye: high Stamina improves precision damage and removes bullet spread
Deadeye precision: more headshot and weakspot damage; Long Shot: no damage falloff during Deadeye
Quick Draw: swaps restore Stamina; California Reaper: precision neutralizations restore Stamina
High Noon: precision neutralizations prime a faster slowed-time reload
Deadeye efficiency: shooting costs less Stamina
Run 'N' Gun: hip-fire costs no Stamina and Focus permits faster movement
Nerves of Tungsten-Steel: precision hits during Deadeye always crit and gain damage at range
